_comment: Every Type.property the served surface cannot write, SPLIT BY INTENT. `hole` = nothing can set it and somebody would want to. `machine_written` = an operation writes it and a caller parameter would be wrong, so `written_by` names that operation. `unused` = nothing writes it and nobody has carried it. A flat count conflated the first two and could not be read as a to-do list. `vocabulary_reach.py --check` fails when a NEW unreachable property appears that this file does not classify.

entries.reason: 0 of 295 carry one. THE CORE TAKES NO CLOCK by design, so a creation timestamp can only ever be caller-supplied, and no caller has wanted one.
